skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: Calculate the area of right $\triangle OCA = \frac{1}{2}(6)(4.1802)\sin(0.8) \approx 8.9961\text{ cm}^2$.
Calculate the area of circular sector $OCD = \frac{1}{2}(OC)^2(0.8) \approx 6.9898\text{ cm}^2$.
Subtract the sector area from the triangle area.
walkthrough:
In the right-angled triangle $\triangle OCA$ (with $AC \perp OB$), calculate the side length $OC$:
$$OC = OA\cos(0.8) = 6\cos(0.8) \approx 6(0.696707) \approx 4.18024\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the area of the right-angled triangle $\triangle OCA$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OCA) = \frac{1}{2} \times OA \times OC \times \sin(0.8) = \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 4.18024 \times \sin(0.8) \approx 8.99614\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of circular sector $OCD$ (radius $r = OC \approx 4.18024\text{ cm}$ and central angle $\theta = 0.8\text{ radians}$):
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } OCD) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(4.18024^2)(0.8) = 0.4 \times 17.4744 \approx 6.98976\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the sector area from the triangle area to find the shaded area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}(\triangle OCA) - \text{Area}(\text{sector } OCD) = 8.99614 - 6.98976 = 2.00638 \approx 2.01\text{ cm}^2$$

ai_rubric.Area of Circular Shapes: Calculates $OC = 6\cos 0.8 \approx 4.18$ (M1, A1). Calculates triangle area $\approx 8.996$ (M1). Calculates sector area $\approx 6.990$ (M1). Subtracts areas (DM1) to obtain $2.01\text{ cm}^2$ (A1).
